# exo_mailbox_spelling_configuration (Resource)

Manages the MailboxSpellingConfiguration configuration via Set-MailboxSpellingConfiguration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `check_before_send` (Boolean) Maps to the -CheckBeforeSend parameter.
- `dictionary_language` (String) Maps to the -DictionaryLanguage parameter.
- `ignore_mixed_digits` (Boolean) Maps to the -IgnoreMixedDigits parameter.
- `ignore_uppercase` (Boolean) Maps to the -IgnoreUppercase parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
